text.tspan: Highway gated fusion | Operators & tensor flow
size16 / layers2 / supplied f=ReLU / learned linear carry / 6 independent Linear modules / read bottom to top
B=batch; size16; first layer expands; layer1 keeps exact independent parameter scopes in IR.
Orange gate / blue transforms / purple Linear / green Sigmoid / yellow Add.
Three branch inputs are the same current x; carry is a learned Linear, not a skip identity.
Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.
E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.
Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.
